title: I gave Gemini 3.6 Flash and GPT-5.6 access to my entire digital life — here’s which one actually helped me…
excerpt: I compared Google's new default AI against OpenAI's default reasoning model
content_html:
Both OpenAI and Google have released major new AI models within days of each other. OpenAI launched GPT-5.6, and Google has followed up with Gemini 3.6 Flash. While both companies have talked up the coding and developer features of these models, they also power the consumer versions of ChatGPT and Gemini.

So, rather than measuring them with programming benchmarks, I wanted to find out which is actually better at the kind of messy, everyday problems most people use AI to solve.

For this comparison, I matched Google's Gemini 3.6 Flash against GPT-5.6 Sol using its default Medium reasoning setting, since both are intended to be the standard high-quality models that paid subscribers will use for most tasks.

My digital life

So, I gave them my entire digital life for the week ahead.

I uploaded:

  • Bank statements
  • My calendar (they had access to my calendar app and I also sent in a screenshot of my calendar from another account I use).
  • Grocery receipts
  • Emails (both had access to my Gmail)
  • WhatsApp screenshots
  • Photos of my kitchen cupboards
  • An energy bill
  • Travel bookings
  • Handwritten notes

Then I gave both models exactly the same instruction:

"Tell me everything I should do this week."

It sounds like a simple request, but it forces an AI to combine information from multiple sources, prioritize what's important, spot deadlines, reconcile conflicting information, and produce a practical action plan. In other words, it's exactly the kind of real-world problem people increasingly expect AI assistants to solve.

The results were like night and day.

Two different approaches

When I uploaded the files to Gemini 3.6 Flash and asked what I should do this week, it largely ignored the photos and concentrated on the screenshot of my calendar. Its initial answer mostly repeated the events I already knew were happening. Thanks, Gemini — I had the calendar open in front of me.

I then had to explicitly ask whether it could infer anything useful from the other images. It eventually offered some additional advice and did a good job of dividing the information into categories, including work, shopping, fitness, notes, and receipts. But it failed to flag that I had two clashing events in my calendar that evening. It also offered very little prioritization or practical guidance about what I should do next.

ChatGPT took considerably longer to respond, but its answer was far more useful. From the WhatsApp screenshots, it correctly deduced that attendance at my Friday Tai Chi class was likely to be low and suggested I decide whether it was still worth running. It noticed that yoga had been canceled, and spotted the two conflicting events in my calendar, telling me that I needed to choose between them.

It also totalled the receipts I had uploaded, suggested what I should do with them, and made a decent attempt at deciphering my handwritten notes. More importantly, it organized everything into a day-by-day plan for the coming week, then identified the three most urgent tasks, so I knew exactly where to begin.

The crucial difference

That was the crucial difference. Gemini told me what was in my files. ChatGPT worked out what I should do with the information. In World Cup terms, ChatGPT scored a hat trick while Gemini missed a penalty.

Google says Gemini 3.6 Flash improves coding, knowledge work, and multimodal performance compared with its previous models. That may be true, but in this particular multimodal test, it was comfortably beaten.

When I asked both AIs to make sense of real life rather than pass a benchmark, ChatGPT reasoned about the information in a far better way than Gemini did..

OpenAI 和谷歌都在几天内相继发布了重要的新人工智能模型。 OpenAI推出了GPT-5.6，谷歌也跟进推出了Gemini 3.6 Flash。 虽然两家公司都谈论了这些模型的编码和开发人员功能，但它们也为 ChatGPT 和 Gemini 的消费者版本提供支持。

因此，我不想用编程基准来衡量它们，而是想找出哪个实际上更适合大多数人使用人工智能来解决的那种混乱的日常问题。

为了进行比较，我使用默认的 Medium 推理设置将 Google 的 Gemini 3.6 Flash 与 GPT-5.6 Sol 进行了匹配，因为两者都旨在成为付费订阅者用于大多数任务的标准高质量模型。

我的数字生活

所以，我把接下来一周的全部数字生活都交给了他们。

我上传：

  • 银行对账单
  • 我的日历（他们可以访问我的日历应用程序，我还从我使用的另一个帐户发送了我的日历的屏幕截图）。
  • 杂货收据
  • 电子邮件（两者都可以访问我的 Gmail）
  • WhatsApp 截图
  • 我的厨房橱柜的照片
  • 能源账单
  • 旅行预订
  • 手写笔记

然后我给两个模型提供了完全相同的指令：

“告诉我这周我应该做的一切。”

订阅突发新闻、评论、观点、顶级技术交易等。

这听起来像是一个简单的请求，但它迫使人工智能结合多个来源的信息，优先考虑重要的事情，确定最后期限，协调冲突的信息，并制定切实可行的行动计划。 换句话说，这正是人们越来越期望人工智能助手能够解决的现实问题。

结果就像白天和黑夜一样。

当我将文件上传到 Gemini 3.6 Flash 并询问我这周应该做什么时，它基本上忽略了照片并集中在我的日历的屏幕截图上。 它最初的回答大多重复了我已经知道正在发生的事件。 谢谢，双子座——我把日历打开在我面前。

然后我必须明确询问它是否可以从其他图像中推断出任何有用的信息。 它最终提供了一些额外的建议，并很好地将信息分类，包括工作、购物、健身、笔记和收据。 但它并没有表明那天晚上我的日历中有两件相互冲突的事情。 它也几乎没有提供关于我下一步应该做什么的优先顺序或实用指导。

ChatGPT 的响应时间要长得多，但它的答案要有用得多。 从 WhatsApp 的屏幕截图中，它正确地推断出我周五太极课的出席率可能很低，并建议我决定是否仍然值得参加。 它注意到瑜伽已被取消，并在我的日历中发现了两个相互冲突的活动，告诉我需要在它们之间进行选择。

它还汇总了我上传的收据，建议我应该如何处理它们，并在破译我的手写笔记方面做出了不错的尝试。 更重要的是，它将所有事情组织成未来一周的日常计划，然后确定了三项最紧迫的任务，所以我确切地知道从哪里开始。

关键的区别

这是关键的区别。 双子座告诉我我的档案里有什么。 ChatGPT 找出了我应该如何处理这些信息。 在世界杯方面，ChatGPT 上演帽子戏法，而 Gemini 罚失点球。

谷歌表示，与之前的型号相比，Gemini 3.6 Flash 改进了编码、知识工作和多模式性能。 这可能是真的，但在这个特殊的多模式测试中，它轻松地被击败了。

当我要求两个人工智能理解现实生活而不是通过基准时，ChatGPT 比 Gemini 更好地推理了信息。
